# A page named above where it is written: a button ahead of the stack, a
# component func, and a handler in an earlier page's content each go to a
# page written below them, with that page's params. A node's own check is
# what completes its handle's type arguments, so each read saw the bare
# declaration and was refused -- `cannot pass page as page[T, M]` -- until the
# checker gave a generic node's handle what its props bind before the body
# around it is checked (preSpecializeHandles).
#
# html serves a page with params only in route mode, where a test does not
# run -- `sngl test` has no route-mode launcher, and a `go` would load another
# document and end the run -- so on html the program is generated: without
# the fix it did not check, on any target.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '^ok +3 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +3 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +3 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '^ok +3 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '^ok +3 tests, 0 failures$'

sngl generate --platform=html --lang=go --out=html app.sngl
exists html/server.go

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import nav "sngl:ui/nav"
import ui "sngl:ui"

struct Book {
    title string
}

struct Shelf {
    name string
}

component library ui.node {
    var seen = ""

    // Goes to a page written below the func.
    func toShelf(name string) {
        pages.go(shelf, Shelf{name=name})
    }

    ui.button #early(text="Early", @click { pages.go(shelf, Shelf{name="early"}) })
    ui.button #byFunc(text="By func", @click { toShelf("func") })
    nav.stack #pages {
        nav.page #home(href="/", title="Home") {
            ui.text(value="home")
        }
        nav.page #book(href=`/b/{title}`, title="Book", params=Book{title="first"}) {
            component content(p) {
                ui.button(text=p.title, @click { pages.go(shelf, Shelf{name=p.title}) })
            }
        }
        nav.page #shelf(href=`/s/{name}`, title="Shelf", params=Shelf{name="first"}) {
            component content(p) {
                ui.text(value=p.name)
                effect(on=p.name, @mount { seen = p.name })
            }
        }
    }
}

func testAButtonAboveGoesToAPageBelow(t test.Test, c library) {
    t.assert(c.pages.current == c.home)
    c.early.click()
    t.assert(c.pages.current == c.shelf)
    t.assert(c.seen == "early")
}

func testAFuncGoesToAPageBelow(t test.Test, c library) {
    c.byFunc.click()
    t.assert(c.pages.current == c.shelf)
    t.assert(c.seen == "func")
}

func testAPageBelowStartsAtItsParams(t test.Test, c library) {
    t.assert(c.seen == "")
    t.assert(c.pages.current.title == "Home")
}

ui.window(title="Library") {
    library()
}
